targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (dl.device_name)
  dl.device_name,
  dl.lat,
  dl.lon,
  dl.time AS last_seen,
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - dl.time)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS hours_since_seen,
  dl.battery_pct AS battery_pct,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  COALESCE(c.color_idx, 0) AS customer_color_idx,
  o.status AS order_status
FROM device_locations dl
JOIN trackers t ON t.device_name = dl.device_name
JOIN order_trackers ot ON ot.tracker_id = t.id AND ot.removed_at IS NULL
JOIN orders o ON o.id = ot.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE ('${customer}' = 'all' OR c.id::text = '${customer}')
  AND ('${order_var}' = 'all' OR o.id::text = '${order_var}')
  AND ('${tracker}' = 'all' OR dl.device_name = '${tracker}')
  AND '${view}' = 'current'
ORDER BY dl.device_name, dl.time DESC

SELECT
  dl.time,
  dl.lat,
  dl.lon,
  dl.device_name,
  c.name AS customer_name,
  COALESCE(c.color_idx, 0) AS customer_color_idx
FROM device_locations dl
JOIN trackers t ON t.device_name = dl.device_name
JOIN order_trackers ot ON ot.tracker_id = t.id AND ot.removed_at IS NULL
JOIN orders o ON o.id = ot.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE ('${customer}' = 'all' OR c.id::text = '${customer}')
  AND ('${order_var}' = 'all' OR o.id::text = '${order_var}')
  AND ('${tracker}' = 'all' OR dl.device_name = '${tracker}')
  AND '${view}' = 'historical'
  AND $__timeFilter(dl.time)
ORDER BY dl.time ASC

WITH current_view AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dl.device_name)
    COALESCE(c.color_idx, 0) AS customer_color_idx,
    dl.device_name,
    dl.time AS last_seen,
    ROUND(dl.lat::numeric, 5) AS lat,
    ROUND(dl.lon::numeric, 5) AS lon,
    ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - dl.time)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS hours_since_seen,
    dl.battery_pct AS battery_pct,
    c.name AS customer,
    o.status AS order_status
  FROM device_locations dl
  JOIN trackers t ON t.device_name = dl.device_name
  JOIN order_trackers ot ON ot.tracker_id = t.id AND ot.removed_at IS NULL
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = ot.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE ('${customer}' = 'all' OR c.id::text = '${customer}')
    AND ('${order_var}' = 'all' OR o.id::text = '${order_var}')
    AND ('${tracker}' = 'all' OR dl.device_name = '${tracker}')
    AND '${view}' = 'current'
  ORDER BY dl.device_name, dl.time DESC
),
historical_view AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(c.color_idx, 0) AS customer_color_idx,
    dl.device_name,
    dl.time AS last_seen,
    ROUND(dl.lat::numeric, 5) AS lat,
    ROUND(dl.lon::numeric, 5) AS lon,
    NULL::numeric AS hours_since_seen,
    dl.battery_pct AS battery_pct,
    c.name AS customer,
    o.status AS order_status
  FROM device_locations dl
  JOIN trackers t ON t.device_name = dl.device_name
  JOIN order_trackers ot ON ot.tracker_id = t.id AND ot.removed_at IS NULL
  JOIN orders o ON o.id = ot.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE ('${customer}' = 'all' OR c.id::text = '${customer}')
    AND ('${order_var}' = 'all' OR o.id::text = '${order_var}')
    AND ('${tracker}' = 'all' OR dl.device_name = '${tracker}')
    AND '${view}' = 'historical'
    AND $__timeFilter(dl.time)
)
SELECT * FROM current_view
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM historical_view
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
